sources.dataset_name: Paddy Doctor: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Paddy Pest and Disease Recognition
sources.publisher: Makerere AI Lab / TNAU / AI4Good Research Consortium
sources.dataset_description: 10,407 high-resolution annotated smartphone field images covering major South Asian rice diseases and pests (Bacterial Leaf Blight, Blast, Brown Spot, Tungro, BPH).
sources.license_evidence: Published in CVPR/ICCV workshop proceedings & GitHub repository with open CC-BY 4.0 LICENSE file.
sources.notes: Primary open-access gold standard for South Indian rice diseases.
sources.acquisition_notes: Successfully ingested 6009 unique CC-BY 4.0 training images across 6 canonical classes (bacterial_leaf_blight, bacterial_leaf_streak, blast, brown_spot, dead_heart/stem_borer, tungro) from local source archive.

sources.dataset_name: PlantDoc: A Dataset for Visual Plant Disease Detection in Natural Field Conditions
sources.publisher: IIT Delhi / University of Delhi (Singh et al.)
sources.dataset_description: Field-condition complex background dataset for agricultural disease detection, including rice blast and blight.
sources.notes: Field images captured with noisy backgrounds; valuable for in-field robustness.
sources.acquisition_notes: DOWNLOAD_BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_ACCESS: Official PlantDoc master release does not contain Oryza sativa classes.
